data.define: Used to tell someone to feel better.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cheer up' to someone grieving.
misuse.why: It sounds like you dismiss their pain.

data.l1_hook: Cổ buồn quá. Giờ làm sao?
data.l1_ex: Cheer up, tụi mình ăn pizza nè!

native.tip: “cheer up” = Vui lên nào. Ví dụ: “Cheer up, we're having pizza!”
native.caption:
“cheer up” nghĩa là gì?
“cheer up” = Vui lên nào.
Ví dụ: “Cheer up, we're having pizza!” (Cheer up, tụi mình ăn pizza nè!)
